correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the sign-PERSISTENT first-reset resolvent h(v,s)=A_g(v,s)+(r A_g(0,+)/(2lambda))s and Green–Kubo D=E[v A_g(v,s)]+r A_g(0,+)E[v s]/(2lambda). For g=av verify exact linear comparator Sigma²/((r+a)(r+a+2lambda))*(2/(r+2a)+1/(2lambda)). Coupling the nonlinear and linear velocities since their last reset gives velocity O_p(r^-1) and difference O_p(r^-4) at fixed lambda,Sigma,g. On no-flip trajectories the cubic correction is -b Sigma³ T^4/4; sign flips contribute one higher inverse-r power. Thus m_g-m_a=-6b Sigma³/r^4+O(r^-5), A_g(0,+)-A_a(0,+)=-6b Sigma³/r^5+O(r^-6), and the remaining vA correction is O(r^-6); two equal slow terms produce -6bSigma^4/(lambda r^5). For tan versus tanh, b=+-1/3, giving +4 Sigma^4/(lambda r^5) with fixed 0<Sigma<1. Pinned VERIFY.py read; its stationary moment Poisson equations were checked analytically. This is an asymptotic proof under strong compact dissipativity, NOT an all-r inequality.
